locator: §4.1, Geach's example, '(P2) Tormenting the cat is bad.'
interpretation: Geach's minor premise applies 'bad', which §2.1 lists among the 'general predicates of negative evaluation'; the entry uses it as the paradigm of a moral sentence whose meaning emotivism must explain. Attribution reading on a secondary witness: the claim records the position the entry reports, not a thesis of the entry's author. No primary text is pinnable (in copyright, no immutable open text).
